preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) and m edges (1 ≤ m ≤ 10^5), and is connected (m ≥ n - 1).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) connects distinct vertices in the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == m and len(set((min(a, b), max(a, b)) for a, b in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly m unique edges (no self-loops or multi-edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No solution' if m % 2 != 0 else any(all(edge in used_edges for edge in path_edges) and len(path_edges) == 2 and len(set(path_edges)) == 2 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= z <= n for x, y, z in paths) for paths in path_solutions for path_edges in [(min(x, y), max(x, y)), (min(y, z), max(y, z))] for x, y, z in paths) and len(path_solutions) == m // 2 and len(set(tuple(sorted(path)) for path in path_solutions)) == m // 2 and len(set((min(x, y), max(x, y)) for x, y, z in paths for path in path_solutions)) == m
postconditions.description: If m is odd, output 'No solution'. Otherwise, output a set of m/2 paths of length 2 (triples (x, y, z)) such that: (1) each path uses two distinct edges (x-y and y-z), (2) all edges are used exactly once across all paths, (3) all vertices in paths are valid (1 ≤ x, y, z ≤ n), and (4) the graph contains all edges in the paths. If no such partition exists, output 'No solution'.
